profile_name: D1b baseline — melee weapon keywords ignored (pre-D1b behaviour)
description: Restores the melee arithmetic the AI used before 2026-08-08: weapon keywords were invisible to every melee estimate, so the AI under-valued exactly the weapons designed to kill what it was looking at. A Beastchoppa (ANTI-VEHICLE 4+) against a T12 hull predicted 0.56 damage against a 1.64 sampled mean. This profile exists so the fix can be EVALUATED — a code change applied to both sides of a mirror cannot be measured from the margin.
